title: The Kaiser and a "Mediocre Man" Theory of History
summary: A historical analysis examining the 'mediocre man' theory of history through the lens of Kaiser Wilhelm II, questioning whether ordinary individuals drive historical outcomes rather than exceptional leaders.
problem_solved: Challenges the traditional 'great man' theory of history by proposing that mediocre individuals may be more responsible for historical events.
why_valuable: Offers an alternative framework for understanding historical causation that contrasts with conventional leadership-focused narratives.
